text:
oncall-bot: PAGER: embeddings-autoscaler (sev-2) triggered at 2026-04-07T03:12:04Z -> 18 affected requests, p95 spike

jamal reyes: picked up pager 03:15 UTC. I'm on it, looking at autoscaler events and node churn.

jamal reyes: quick snapshot: p95 embedding latency jumped from ~120ms -> 1.2s around 03:10. Autoscaler launched 6 new pods but they never finished warmup, causing KV misses.

li zhang: logs look like rolling config change to autoscaler.policy.maxBurst applied at 03:08. I see a rollout of autoscaler v2 with new cooldown=0s, likely too aggressive.

mira patel: confirmed increased eviction rate on redis-kv: evictions/sec went from 2 -> 48 at same window. Might be related to aggressive scaling causing rebalances.

jamal reyes: mitigation actions applied 03:22: rolled back autoscaler to previous stable manifest and bumped minReplicas=4. Also triggered a cache priming job for hot prefixes. Observability: error budget alarm cleared at 03:40.

alex chen: handoff notes for day shift (summary + action items) — quick bullets so next 12h oncall has everything: 
- What happened: autoscaler rollout with cooldown=0 caused rapid pod churn + cold KV caches -> p95 spike + transient 503s for a small subset of customers.
- Impact: short-lived customer 503s (estimated 30m spike window). No data loss. Major customers saw degraded latency; ticket #CUST-541 started by support.
- Current status (as of 04:00 UTC): mitigations in place, traffic stable, p95 back to baseline, autoscaler rolled back. Cache priming job completed successfully.
- Ownership next 12h: jamal reyes (primary), mira patel (secondary). If jamal unavailable, ping li zhang.
- Coverage gap: EU-WEST overlap 02:00-04:00 local rotation still uncovered for next 36h (we had double rotation change). We will be taking async pager for EU-WEST spikes — ops oncall aware.
- Runbooks & links: KV evictions runbook: https://console/internal/runbooks/kv-eviction ; Autoscaler postmortem template: https://console/internal/templates/autoscaler-pm ; Pager details: https://pagerduty.internal/incidents/EDG-872

mira patel: noted coverage gap. Action: I'll loop in infra-rotation to patch the schedule and add a sticky note on the calendar.

li zhang: monitoring checks to keep an eye on (commands):
```
# recent p95 for embeddings service
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?m=service.embeddings.p95&from=now-2h" | jq .

# check redis evictions
kubectl -n infra exec -it redis-primary -- redis-cli info stats | grep evicted_keys

# verify autoscaler version
kubectl -n infra get deploy embeddings-autoscaler -o yaml | yq '.spec.template.metadata.annotations.version'
```

jamal reyes: next steps (short):
- 1) schedule a controlled canary for autoscaler v2 with staggered cooldown and 1h observation window. Assigned: jamal. ETA: 48h.
- 2) add automated cache warmup for new pods as part of the deployment. Assigned: li. ETA: 72h.
- 3) update runbook to include a checklist for "on-rollout cache priming". Assigned: alex. ETA: EOD.

alex chen: important troubleshooting notes for whoever gets paged:
- Fast check: if p95 rises while cpu utilization low and new replicas exist -> check cooldown and pod readiness probes.
- If redis evictions spike, run priming job before rolling back if you can tolerate short latency.
- Fallback: route heavy embedding requests to embedding-legacy model (policy: route-fallback/embed-legacy) via console if immediate relief needed.

mira patel: ACK, I'm available until 14:00 UTC. @jamal if you need air cover for the canary, ping me and I can run the traffic cutover. :thumbsup:

jamal reyes: taking primary. I'll update the incident ticket with final timeline and attach logs. Leaving this thread as the formal handoff.

oncall-bot: NOTE: runbook link added to incident ticket by alex at 04:05 UTC.

alex chen: thanks all. If anything regresses, escalate to SEV-1 channel and @oncall-manager. Otherwise I'll file the initial postmortem draft by EOD and assign reviewers.
